summary.en: Windows & macOS Spotify & 6-cloud music player with bilingual lyrics, Dynamic Island & Flow.
summary.zh-CN: 支持 6 大个人音乐云盘、双语逐字歌词、跨屏灵动岛与流光背景的 Windows / macOS 播放器。
summary.zh-TW: 支援 6 大個人音樂雲端、雙語逐字歌詞、跨螢幕靈動島與流光背景的 Windows / macOS 播放器。
summary.ja: 6 つのクラウド音楽ドライブ・二言語歌詞・マルチモニター対応アイランド・Flow 背景を備えた音楽プレーヤー。
summary.ko: 6대 클라우드 음악 드라이브, 이중 언어 가사, 다이내믹 아일랜드, Flow 배경을 지원하는 플레이어.

description.en: An independent fork of MySpotify for Windows and macOS built with MyGo's native UI. Adds a personal Cloud Music Disk supporting 6 providers (OneDrive, Google Drive, Baidu Netdisk, Quark Drive, 115 Drive, WebDAV) with visual folder picking, play-while-caching, and automatic matching for local Spotify playlist tracks, alongside an embedded multi-source bilingual lyrics engine (NetEase, QQ Music, LRCLIB), a draggable multi-monitor Dynamic Island with instant click-through unlock, word-timed bilingual stage animations, Apple Music-style GPU Flow backdrop, iOS-style Liquid Glass controls, unified track covers, and sticky playlist search.
description.zh-CN: 基于 MyGo 原生界面开发的独立定制版播放器，支持 Windows 与 macOS。新增 6 大个人音乐云盘直连（OneDrive、Google Drive、百度网盘、夸克网盘、115 网盘、WebDAV），支持可视化选目录、边播边缓存与自动点亮歌单灰歌；内置多源双语逐字歌词（网易云、QQ 音乐、LRCLIB）、自由拖动跨屏灵动岛与锁定悬停解锁、Apple Music 风格 GPU 流光背景、iOS 风格液态玻璃控件、统一专辑封面与歌单简繁吸顶搜索。
